notes: This JSON is a structured transcription of the printed kosher-supervision list.
Certification codes (e.g. OU, OK, KLBD, MK, Star-K, Kedassia, KSA) indicate that ONLY the product bearing that specific hechsher symbol/code is approved.
'Nicht Koscher' = Not Kosher. 'Nicht für Pessach' = Not kosher for Passover (but fine rest of year). 'Ok' = approved.
Entries under 'Neu für 2026' are newly added items for this edition; entries under 'Von der Liste gestrichen' were removed.
